# API signatures

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_api_signatures.py from sweep 0.3.6; do not edit by hand -->

Generated with `inspect` from the installed package. Regenerate after upgrading sweep: `python scripts/gen_api_signatures.py -o references/api-signatures.md`.

Contents: top level and binding probes; PropTorch; memory/eager options; PropJax; PropSEM and SEM equations; signals, datasets, parallel; finite-difference equations (capability table, constructors).

## `sweep` (top level)

### `sweep.precompile`

```text
precompile(require_gpu: 'bool' = True) -> 'bool'
```

Make sure a CUDA core for ``sweep._C`` exists now.

### `sweep.is_torch_binding_available`

```text
is_torch_binding_available() -> 'bool'
```

Return True when ``sweep._C`` can be used for ``impl='c'`` — either a compiled extension is already on disk, or PyTorch + a CUDA GPU are present and the CUDA core is at hand: the prebuilt one the wheel ships for your torch's CUDA major and GPU (nothing compiles on first use; the shim is ctypes), else an nvcc to build one. Does NOT load or build anything (see ``sweep.backend.c.jit``).

### `sweep.backend.torch.binding.is_available`

```text
is_available() -> 'bool'
```

True when the ``sweep._C`` backend is **usable** here -- an ahead-of-time extension is on disk, or PyTorch, a CUDA GPU and a CUDA core (the wheel's prebuilt one, nothing to compile; else a suitable ``nvcc`` -- torch's CUDA major, >= 12.4 for CUDA 12, >= 12.8 for a Blackwell target, or a CUDA 13 nvcc -- to build one) are present. Does NOT load or compile anything.

### `sweep.backend.torch.binding.is_compiled`

```text
is_compiled() -> 'bool'
```

True when the first ``impl='c'`` use costs nothing: an ahead-of-time extension; the ctypes shim already holding the core library in this process; or, under ``SWEEP_JIT_FULL``, a module compiled in this process or a cached ``sweep_C.so`` from a previous JIT run.

### `sweep.backend.torch.binding.diagnostics`

```text
diagnostics() -> 'dict'
```

Diagnostics for the compiled backend -- usable / why-not / nvcc / built.

## `sweep.propagator.torch.PropTorch`

PyTorch propagator. ``impl='eager'`` is pure torch (CPU or GPU); ``impl='c'`` is the prebuilt CUDA core (``sweep/lib/cu<major>/libsweep_core.so``) driven through the pure-Python ctypes layer ``sweep.backend.c`` -- CUDA GPU only, nothing compiles after ``pip install``. ``impl=None`` means ``'auto'``: ``'c'`` when ``sweep.is_torch_binding_available()``, the equation declares ``C_NAME`` and the propagator's device is CUDA (``device=``, else the equation's device), else ``'eager'``; an explicit ``impl='c'`` that cannot be honoured falls back to eager with a UserWarning. ``backend=None`` inherits the equation's backend. ``cuda_options=`` applies to ``impl='c'`` only, ``eager_options=`` to ``impl='eager'``; ``memory=`` (``Full()`` / ``BoundarySaving()`` / ``Ckpt()``) is impl-agnostic (default: boundary saving on 'c' -- full storage for equations without compiled boundary saving -- and chunked ckpt on eager).

### `PropTorch(...)`

```text
PropTorch(equation, shape, source_type=None, receiver_type=None, abcn=50, free_surface=False,
    topography=None, topo_method='auto', dh=10.0, dt=0.002, dev=None, device=None, use_ckpt=None,
    ckpt_chunks=100, ckpt_mode='chunk', ckpt_num=0, ckpt_storage='gpu', ckpt_pinned_memory=None,
    pml_type=None, nt=-1, B=1, allow_growth=True, boundary_saving_config=None, boundary_buffer=None,
    *, backend=None, impl=None, backend_options=None, eager_options=None, cuda_options=None,
    memory=None)
```

`PropTorch.__init__` is `(*args, backend, impl, backend_options, eager_options, cuda_options, memory, **kwargs)`; `*args`/`**kwargs` go to the base constructor shown here (parameters of `PropBase.__init__`). Any other keyword raises `TypeError`.

### `PropTorch.forward / __call__`

```text
forward(wavelet, sources, receivers, models=None, adj=False, return_wavefield=False, **kwargs)
```

Returns the record `(B, nt, nrec, len(receiver_type))`. With `impl='eager'` and `return_wavefield=True`: `(record, snapshots)`. Extra call keywords accepted by the eager backend: `snapshot_times`, `snapshot_interval`, `snapshot_grid`.

### `PropTorch.register_gradient  (impl='eager' only)`

```text
register_gradient(param_name, imaging_fn, mode='gradient', imaging_type=None)
```

Register a user-defined imaging condition for a model parameter.

### `PropTorch.clear_gradients  (impl='eager' only)`

```text
clear_gradients()
```

Remove all registered custom gradient / imaging conditions.

### `PropTorch.imaging  (impl='eager' only)`

```text
imaging(wavelet, sources, receivers, models=None, adjoint_source=None, observed=None)
```

Explicit RTM/imaging using the registered ``mode='imaging'`` condition(s). Does NOT touch any ``param.grad``.

## `sweep.propagator.options`

### `Full`

```text
Full() -> None
```

Keep everything the backward needs in memory. No parameters, by nature.

### `BoundarySaving`

```text
BoundarySaving(storage: "Literal['gpu', 'cpu', 'disk']" = 'gpu', transfer_interval: 'int | None' =
    None, pinned_memory: 'bool | None' = None, disk_dir: 'str | None' = None, ring_buffers: 'int |
    None' = None, disk_async_read: 'bool' = False, storage_dtype: "Literal['fp32', 'fp16', 'bf16',
    'int8']" = 'fp32', tail_steps: 'int | None' = None) -> None
```

Reconstruct the forward wavefield from saved boundary values.

### `Ckpt`

```text
Ckpt(mode: "Literal['chunk', 'recursive']" = 'chunk', chunks: 'int' = 100, count: 'int' = 0,
    storage: "Literal['gpu', 'cpu']" = 'gpu', pinned_memory: 'bool | None' = None) -> None
```

Rematerialise the forward wavefield from checkpoints.

### `EagerOptions`

```text
EagerOptions(use_compile: 'bool' = True, compile_mode: 'str' = 'default', compile_dynamic: 'bool' =
    False, compile_backend: 'str | None' = None, compile_fullgraph: 'bool' = False,
    store_last_wavefield: 'bool' = False, cpml_strips: 'bool' = False) -> None
```

EagerOptions(use_compile: 'bool' = True, compile_mode: 'str' = 'default', compile_dynamic: 'bool' = False, compile_backend: 'str | None' = None, compile_fullgraph: 'bool' = False, store_last_wavefield: 'bool' = False, cpml_strips: 'bool' = False)

### `CUDAOptions`

```text
CUDAOptions(memory: 'MemoryOptions | None' = None) -> None
```

CUDAOptions(memory: 'MemoryOptions | None' = None)

### `sweep.propagator.last_grad_split_iii`

```text
last_grad_split_iii()
```

Term III of the last split LSRTM backward, on the model grid, or None.

## `sweep.propagator.jax.PropJax`

### `PropJax(...)`

```text
PropJax(*args, backend=None, memory=None, scan_unroll=1, **kwargs)
```

`*args`/`**kwargs` are the `PropBase.__init__` parameters listed under PropTorch. Needs `pip install 'sweep-solver[jax]'` and an equation built with `backend='jax'`.

### `PropJax.forward / __call__`

```text
forward(wavelet, sources, receivers, models=None, return_wavefield=False, adj=False, **kwargs)
```

## `sweep.sem`

### `PropSEM(...)`

```text
PropSEM(equation=<class 'sweep.sem.equations.acoustic2d.AcousticSEM2D'>, *, shape, dh, dt, nt=None,
    n_order: 'int' = 4, abcn=None, free_surface=False, topography=None, memory=None, f_dominant:
    'float' = 10.0, impl=None, device=None, dev=None, dtype: 'torch.dtype' = torch.float32, density:
    'float' = 1000.0, bs_band_mode: 'str' = 'full', bs_store_dtype_elem=None, source_type=None,
    receiver_type=None, equation_options=None, **kwargs)
```

SEM propagator with the FD ``PropTorch`` constructor and call.

```text
ModelParallel(prop, mesh: 'MeshTopology') -> 'None'
```

Run a single-domain :class:`PropTorch` decomposed across GPUs (model parallel / domain decomposition) — a strategy wrapper in the spirit of ``torch.nn.parallel.DistributedDataParallel``::

### `sweep.parallel.pad_to_mesh`

```text
unpad_from_mesh(arr, orig_shape: 'Sequence[int]', mesh=None, *, py: 'int' = 1, px: 'int' = 1)
```

Slice a padded array back to the physical grid — loudly.

## Finite-difference equations (`sweep.equations`)

Instantiated on the CPU with defaults (`backend='torch'`). `src`/`rec` = default `source_type`/`receiver_type`; `src ok`/`rec ok` = every field accepted. `c` = compiled CUDA kernels exist (`impl='c'`). `FS` = free surface accepted; `per-edge` = per-edge free surface on eager/c. `BS` = boundary saving on c/eager. `(B,...) models` = per-shot batched models on impl='c'.

| `ViscoElastic` | 2 | `['vp', 'vs', 'rho', 'Qp', 'Qs']` | `['sxx', 'szz']` | `['vx', 'vz', 'sxx', 'szz', 'sxz']` | `['vx', 'vz']` | `['vx', 'vz', 'sxx', 'szz']` | `cpmls` | yes | yes | yes/yes | no/yes | no |
